ROLE: observer
You review the results of an incident investigation. Write a short summary of what the latest results show, then update the list of hypotheses (at most 4, most likely first).

Root-cause categories:
- bad_deployment: a new release introduced a defect (errors begin right after a deploy)
- db_connection_pool_exhaustion: every database connection in the pool is in use, so requests wait
- slow_query_missing_index: a database query became slow (for example a missing index)
- downstream_timeout: a dependency the service calls is slow or unresponsive
- memory_leak_oom: memory grows until the process is killed (OOM) and restarts
- disk_full: a volume is full so writes fail
- expired_tls_cert: a TLS certificate expired so handshakes fail
- misconfiguration: a wrong environment variable, setting or feature flag
- traffic_spike_rate_limit: request volume far above capacity, causing rate limiting or load shedding
- cache_stampede_outage: the cache is down or emptied so everything falls through to the database

Each hypothesis has root_cause_category (one of the categories), rationale, and supporting_evidence_ids (only IDs that appear in the evidence below).

Reply with only JSON in this shape:
{"summary": "...", "hypotheses": [{"root_cause_category": "disk_full", "rationale": "...", "supporting_evidence_ids": ["L-0123"]}]}

Alert: search-service: HTTP error rate above 5% for 5 minutes (since 14:44 UTC)
Alerting service: search
Alert time: 2026-07-29T14:44:00Z
Data available from 2026-07-29T13:00:00Z to 2026-07-29T16:00:00Z

Evidence so far (the latest results are steps 3 onwards):
Step 1: metrics_query {"end": "2026-07-29T15:00:00Z", "metric": "error_rate_pct", "service": "search", "start": "2026-07-29T14:30:00Z"} (asked because: Check the error rate metric for the search service to see when and how high the errors spike.)
  Result: M-050: Only 7 points in this range, too few to test for a change; use a wider range.
  [M-050] search.error_rate_pct from 2026-07-29T14:30:00Z to 2026-07-29T15:00:00Z (7 points, 5-minute steps): min=0.28 max=22.94 mean=16.45 last=22.94; mean=16.45. Only 7 points in this range, too few to test for a change; use a wider range. Notable points: 2026-07-29T14:35:00Z = 0.28 (lowest); 2026-07-29T15:00:00Z = 22.94 (last); 2026-07-29T15:00:00Z = 22.94 (peak).
Step 2: log_search {"end": "2026-07-29T14:50:00Z", "level": "ERROR", "limit": 30, "service": "search", "start": "2026-07-29T14:40:00Z"} (asked because: Search for error logs in the search service around the alert time to find the root cause.)
  Result: 9 matching log lines.
  [L-0259] 2026-07-29T14:40:06Z search ERROR write failed: No space left on device (errno=28) path=/var/log/search/app.log
  [L-0263] 2026-07-29T14:40:35Z search ERROR WAL archiving failed: could not write file: No space left on device
  [L-0271] 2026-07-29T14:42:31Z search ERROR request failed status=502 path=/api/v1/stock request_id=req-0a587fae
  [L-0275] 2026-07-29T14:43:03Z search ERROR upstream returned 503 for /api/v1/stock request_id=req-acbd7aba
  [L-0276] 2026-07-29T14:44:00Z search ERROR upstream returned 503 for /api/v1/stock request_id=req-a76e6852
  [L-0278] 2026-07-29T14:44:11Z search ERROR request failed status=500 path=/api/v1/stock request_id=req-6c4243ad duration_ms=11864
  [L-0282] 2026-07-29T14:45:04Z search ERROR upstream returned 503 for /api/v1/stock request_id=req-9feab1ff
  [L-0284] 2026-07-29T14:45:16Z search ERROR request failed status=502 path=/api/v1/stock request_id=req-8d9564b8
  [L-0285] 2026-07-29T14:45:41Z search ERROR request failed status=500 path=/api/v1/stock request_id=req-d7f80dba duration_ms=13709
Step 3: metrics_query {"end": "2026-07-29T15:00:00Z", "metric": "disk_used_pct", "service": "search", "start": "2026-07-29T14:00:00Z"} (asked because: Check disk usage percentage for the search service to confirm the disk full hypothesis.)
  Result: M-049: Change detected at 2026-07-29T14:15:00Z: mean 67.88 before, 91.89 after (6.9 baseline standard deviations).
  [M-049] search.disk_used_pct from 2026-07-29T14:00:00Z to 2026-07-29T15:00:00Z (13 points, 5-minute steps): min=63.56 max=98.6 mean=86.35 last=98.6; mean=86.35. Change detected at 2026-07-29T14:15:00Z: mean 67.88 before, 91.89 after (6.9 baseline standard deviations). Notable points: 2026-07-29T14:00:00Z = 63.56 (lowest); 2026-07-29T14:15:00Z = 76.92 (first point after the change); 2026-07-29T15:00:00Z = 98.6 (last); 2026-07-29T15:00:00Z = 98.6 (peak).
Step 4: runbook_retrieve {"query": "disk full No space left on device clean up logs disk space"} (asked because: Retrieve runbook instructions for handling disk full incidents.)
  Result: 3 runbook sections; best match R-17-8 (match score 8.8).
  [R-17-8] Scheduled batch job missed - Related runbooks (match score 8.8): If the job failed to sign in, use the secrets rotation runbook. If the job filled a disk while running, use the disk full runbook, and if it ran but fell behind other work, use the queue backlog runbook.
  [R-06-2] Disk full - Symptoms (match score 6.3): Saving things starts failing out of the blue, usually after a long, quiet creep upward that nobody noticed. Errors begin abruptly once the space runs out, and a warning about the volume being nearly full often exists from hours earlier.
  [R-06-6] Disk full - Verify recovery (match score 5.8): Disk use should drop comfortably below the alert threshold, saving should work again and failures should stop. Check that whatever filled the disk is not still growing before closing the incident.

Previous hypotheses:
- disk_full: Error logs explicitly show 'No space left on device (errno=28)' for app log writes and WAL archiving, directly causing the service errors. (evidence: L-0259, L-0263)

response: {"summary": "Error logs explicitly show 'No space left on device' (errno=28) errors and disk usage metrics confirm disk utilization reaching 98.6% around the time errors spiked, confirming a disk full incident.", "hypotheses": [{"root_cause_category": "disk_full", "rationale": "Logs explicitly report 'No space left on device' when writing logs and WAL files, and disk utilization metrics show disk usage reaching 98.6%.", "supporting_evidence_ids": ["L-0259", "L-0263", "M-049"]}]}
